patch.value: Retrieve same-tracker labelled exemplars for evaluation and calibration

Deterministic lexical (BM25) same-tracker exemplar retrieval for eval and calibrate, optional local embedding similarity, budgeted typed exemplar context, majority-class and kNN baselines beside the model arms, and exemplar-aware calibrated channel identity.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Starting retrieval-augmented evaluation: in-process BM25 over title/body with leakage guards (target, future items, evaluation sample excluded), budgeted typed exemplar context (--exemplar-tokens, default 1200), optional local qwen3-embedding:0.6b similarity falling back to lexical, majority-class and kNN-vote baselines beside the with/without-exemplar model arms, and the exemplar setting folded into the calibrated channel identity. No production triage/link decision path changes; the 0.9 precision gate is untouched.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Implementation and regressions complete: new in-process BM25 exemplar ranking over title/body (deterministic ties by item ids), leakage guards excluding the target, items created after it and evaluation-sample items, optional local qwen3-embedding:0.6b similarity with whole-corpus batching and per-corpus lexical fallback, four-characters-per-token budgeted typed exemplar context, majority-class and kNN-vote baselines beside the with/without-exemplar model arms, and the exemplar setting folded into the calibrated channel key (legacy task/model keys unchanged). Independent behavioural revert proofs, each with only the named function reverted and the source restored byte-for-byte afterwards: (1) eligibleExemplars returned the unfiltered pool -> node --test --test-name-pattern='exemplar eligibility refuses' test/exemplar-retrieval.test.ts fails 0/1; (2) exemplarContext ignored the budget -> 'exemplar context truncates' fails 0/1; (3) similarityOrder lost the id tie-break -> 'bm25 ranking is similarity-ordered' fails 0/1; (4) calibrationKey dropped the exemplar setting -> 'persisted exemplar settings validate' fails 0/1 and 'exemplar calibration identity separates' fails 0/1. All mutants exited 1; no timeouts. Full suite now runs 200/200 tests with unchanged 100 percent statements/branches/functions/lines and zero duplication.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Complete resumed triage cohort: local tev1:4b, seed 20261018, sample 40, k=4, requested exemplar budget 1200, identical historical source archives/example hashes. Type accuracy / ECE: majority 35.0% / 0.6500000000000000; kNN 45.0% / 0.1645833333333334; plain model 50.0% / 0.1289355135892542; exemplar model 47.5% / 0.2531809288279711. Priority accuracy / ECE: majority 57.5% / 0.4250000000000000; kNN 55.0% / 0.1625000000000000; plain model 60.0% / 0.1255807762835390; exemplar model 42.5% / 0.2496073295197622. All arms answered 40/40. Exemplars hurt both triage accuracies and ECE; kNN alone beats the exemplar model on priority. The run made 79 successful model requests, with one empty budgeted-context arm reusing the validated plain answer. All 40 budgets were clamped to prompt headroom; mean retrieved count 3.825. Link measurement now runs serially with the same settings.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Completed four-arm measurement, local tev1:4b, seed 20261018, sample 40, fixed lexical k=4 and requested 1200 tokens. Link kind accuracy / ECE: majority 35.294117647058826% / 0.6470588235294117 (12/34); kNN 29.411764705882354% / 0.5882352941176471 (10/34); plain model 40.0% / 0.1095933423023699 (16/40); exemplar model 32.5% / 0.1546364205833196 (13/40). Six link baseline abstentions are explicit. Together with the prior triage comment, exemplars lower all three accuracies and worsen all three ECEs; kNN beats the exemplar model on priority. Full-precision four-arm metrics, per-class precision/recall, coverage curves and receipts are in calibration/exemplar-report-v1.json and the README table. Both cohorts match the historical archive digests and exact first 40 example hashes; an independent baseline calculation matches every baseline result. The complete resumed cohorts made 153 successful model calls (79 triage, 74 link), zero failed responses and seven reused validated plain answers. This total excludes incomplete earlier cohorts. All six fitted model channels have null thresholds at the unchanged 0.9 precision gate; folds are 19 calibration / 21 validation, too small to establish that bound even if perfect.
